description: Source code for cellular parameter processing, including functions for converting, destroying, and processing cellular configuration data using msgpack serialization.

methods.name: celldoc_convert
methods.description: Converts a buffer into a celldoc_t structure using msgpack.

methods.name: celldoc_destroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a celldoc_t structure and its members.

methods.name: celldoc_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string description of error codes related to celldoc processing.

methods.name: process_cellularparams
methods.description: Processes msgpack map into cellularparam_t structure, extracting 'CellularModemEnable'.

methods.name: process_celldoc
methods.description: Processes variable arguments to populate celldoc_t structure, including sub-document name, version, transaction ID, and cellular parameters.
